name: Cockatrice Spit
body:
Price 1,000 gp

DETAILS

Type poison (contact, injury, ingested); Save Fortitude DC 12; Frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; Cure 1 save

EFFECT

1d2 Dex damage (a creature who takes Dexterity damage equal to its Dexterity score from this poison becomes petrified; each day, a petrified victim can attempt a new DC 12 Fortitude save to recover from the venom and become unpetrified with an amount of Dexterity damage equal to 1 point less than its Dexterity score);
